name: plateia
description: Event-driven ticketing platform with micro frontends (Module Federation) and Fastify microservices.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n catalog,booking,payment,mfe-catalog,mfe-booking,shell -c blue,magenta,yellow,cyan,green,white "npm run dev -w @plateia/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/booking-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-catalog" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-booking" "npm run dev -w @plateia/shell"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n catalog,booking,payment -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w @plateia/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/booking-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/payment-service"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n mfe-catalog,mfe-booking,shell -c cyan,green,white "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-catalog" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-booking" "npm run dev -w @plateia/shell"
